name: Platform admin preserves the existing workspace and creates an isolated second tenant
description: Verifies existing CareGrid data is retained under the primary tenant and a platform admin can create and switch to an isolated second tenant.
steps: Sign in as the existing administrator after the upgrade
Open Tenants
Create a second tenant with its own tenant-admin credentials
Use the tenant switcher to open the new tenant
expected: The original workspace remains intact, the second tenant opens as a separate workspace, and records from the original tenant are not shown in the second tenant.

name: Tenant admin creates caregiver and patient roles with scoped capabilities
description: Verifies tenant administrators can create care-team and patient accounts while role permissions control what each account can change.
steps: Create a patient record
Open Users
Create a caregiver account
Create a patient account linked to that patient
Sign in as the patient
expected: The patient sees only their own care context and cannot manage tenants, users, branding, people or devices, while allowed patient actions remain available.

name: Patient generates revocable loved-one read-only access
description: Verifies a patient can create a loved-one viewer account that is restricted to the patient's information and can later be revoked.
steps: Sign in as a patient
Open Sharing
Generate loved-one access for an email
Sign in with the generated viewer credentials
Confirm editing controls are absent
Sign back in as the patient and revoke the share
expected: The loved-one account can monitor the linked patient but cannot edit data, and access is removed after revocation.

name: Caregiver uses mobile patient-detail dropdowns without losing the full patient workspace
covers: safe startup with stale local session data
description: Verifies the patient workspace remains complete while mobile users can expand patient-detail sections as compact dropdowns.
steps: Sign in as a caregiver or tenant admin on mobile
Open Overview and select a patient
Expand Profile & medical background and save optional details
Expand Latest vitals, Health trends, Care details and Complete timeline
Toggle dark mode and confirm the dropdown workflow remains usable
expected: Patient-detail sections are collapsible on mobile, each section reveals the same patient information and editing controls when expanded, and the desktop-oriented data model and existing CareGrid functionality remain unchanged.

name: Tenant admin configures core and optional dashboard presets with circular trends
description: Verifies all four CareGrid clinical pillars remain dashboard choices, optional Assisted Living and Fitness modes can be enabled, and the Overview can display circular operational trends without replacing existing widgets.
steps: Sign in as a tenant admin
Open Dashboards
Confirm Diabetes, Hypertension, Cardiovascular health and Stroke prevention are always available
Enable Assisted Living and Fitness
Choose Cardiovascular health as the default and save
Return to Overview and switch among available dashboard views
expected: The selected default dashboard persists for the tenant, optional dashboards appear only when enabled, and the existing CareGrid dashboard remains intact with added preset context and circular monitoring/completion trends.
